abstract: Maintains aircraft airworthiness dispatch reliability and single-engine fleet capacity records
system_message:
You are Training Fleet Maintenance Lead (MAINT). The Training Fleet Maintenance Lead (MAINT) tracks aircraft airworthiness dispatch reliability, single-engine fleet capacity metrics, and engine maintenance intervals across prospective training academies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains aircraft airworthiness dispatch reliability and single-engine fleet capacity records（AIRW）
information_points.content:
MAINT-AIRW-UZX：For Nordic Aviation Flight Academy, the maintenance dispatch tracking log shows a fleet dispatch reliability rate of 98% across scheduled cadet training sorties during the preceding academic year, while the single-engine piston training allocation provides a primary single-engine flight training capacity of 60 cadet/year.
MAINT-AIRW-0A3：For Central European Flight Institute, the maintenance dispatch tracking log records a fleet dispatch reliability rate of 88% for scheduled cadet syllabus sorties over the preceding academic year, with single-engine training aircraft supporting a primary single-engine flight training capacity of 80 cadet/year.
MAINT-AIRW-YHF：For Iberian Aeronautical Training Center, scheduled cadet syllabus training sorties during the preceding academic year achieved a fleet dispatch reliability rate of 95%, alongside a primary single-engine flight training capacity of 80 cadet/year based on its single-engine piston fleet allocation.

information_points.title: Piston engine overhaul program（ENGOH）
information_points.content:
MAINT-ENGOH-JTP：For Central European Flight Institute, engine maintenance records reflect an average time before overhaul margin of 600 h remaining on active propulsion units before required factory overhaul.
MAINT-ENGOH-GNL：For Nordic Aviation Flight Academy, the engine maintenance tracking ledger indicates an average time before overhaul margin of 400 h across all active aircraft engines in the training fleet.
MAINT-ENGOH-4BR：For Iberian Aeronautical Training Center, the primary propulsion units across the training fleet maintain an average time before overhaul margin of 800 h prior to mandatory factory overhaul.
